searchText: > Are there social measures published? not that i'm aware of > More to the concrete side: are there explicit correlations measured of transactions on-chain right after an ACD call, how about an Ethstaker's? And Vitalik appearing with some TV celebrity? i think you overestimate how many people watch the call live 🙃 and how much new information is produced as a result. it's mostly confirming async discussions that have already taken place. not sure about the vitalik thing, but my gut also says probably nothing significant there 😩 https://twitter.com/bramcohen/status/1454321393584066564?s=20 (This is not a "surprise" publication or anything; just take a look at the email addresses of the authors 😉 ) If you want to discuss it more: https://ethresear.ch/t/change-fork-choice-rule-to-mitigate-balancing-and-reorging-attacks/11127/2 , and of course https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2353 . Hi Guys. Does anyone know if there exist a database with transaction data per individual for ETH2.0? Or alternatively, once on the chain, is there a way to get this data from there? Please don't cross-post thought it is a different forum! Sorry for that. It is, but there is a significant overlap in people in all these servers 😉 Sorry for that, again! No worries, you probably didn't know yet. Now you do 🙂
